Beyond LED upgrades, we handle all electrical needs for strata properties — from routine maintenance, safety switches and smoke alarm compliance to common area lighting and full rewires. We also do air conditioning services and installs. Verity is your single point of contact for everything electrical across your buildings, so you're not juggling multiple trades.
Most owners see payback within 12-18 months through reduced power bills alone. LEDs use about 75% less energy than halogens. Add in the eliminated call-outs for globe replacements (LEDs last 10+ years), and the savings compound significantly. We calculate exact figures for each property.
Absolutely. Verity has extensive experience with strata properties and understands the approval processes involved. For larger buildings or common areas, we'll provide a detailed timeline upfront so everyone knows what to expect.
